description: This file defines a PHP trait 'EndpointV2SerializerTrait' providing helper functions for setting request options related to endpoint resolution, headers, and URL schemes in the AWS SDK for PHP.

methods.name: setEndpointV2RequestOptions
methods.description: Sets endpoint, headers, and URL scheme based on the resolved endpoint and client configuration.

methods.name: applyHeaders
methods.description: Merges headers from the endpoint into the request headers if they exist.

methods.name: applyScheme
methods.description: Replaces the URL scheme with a custom scheme if specified in the endpoint configuration.
